title: Blueprint
description: A blueprint defines a kind of catalog entity, such as service or team: the properties its entities have, including relations to other entities, and the tabs of widgets its catalog and entity pages add.

properties.description: The entities' properties, keyed by name, in the order the catalog shows them. Every entity also has the built-in fields identifier, title, blueprint, integration, createdAt and updatedAt.

property.description: A value entities have. Integrations write stored properties and relations; the portal works out lookups, computed properties and scorecard results. Which it is follows from its keys: relation, scorecard, lookup or compute, or otherwise stored.

propertyTitle.description: The property's label. Defaults to its name.

propertyDescription.description: Help shown beside the property, saying what it holds.

valueType.description: The JSON type of the values. Dates and URLs are strings with a format.

format.description: String values only: what the text is, which decides how it's checked and shown.

enum.description: The only values allowed, of the property's type. String, number and integer properties only.

storedProperty.description: A value integrations write, checked against its type and constraints.

pattern.description: String properties only: a regular expression (Go RE2 syntax) values must match.

minLength.description: String properties only: the fewest characters.

maxLength.description: String properties only: the most characters.

minimum.description: Number and integer properties only: the lowest value.

maximum.description: Number and integer properties only: the highest value.

relationProperty.description: Identifiers of entities of another blueprint, which integrations write. Paths follow it to the related entity's fields, such as owner.title.

relation.description: The blueprint whose entities it points at.

many.description: Holds a list of identifiers rather than one.

scorecardProperty.description: An entity's result on a scorecard, which the scorecard works out. Paths follow it into tier, score and checks, such as readiness.tier.

scorecard.description: The scorecard whose result it holds; it scores this blueprint.

lookupProperty.description: A value read from a related entity, which the portal keeps up to date.

lookup.description: A path following 1 to 3 relations and ending on a field, such as owner.slackChannel. No $.

type.description: Optional: it defaults to the looked-up field's.

computedProperty.description: A value worked out with jq from the entity's other fields.

compute.description: jq over the entity, such as .tier == "critical".

typedValues.description: Ties format, items and enum values to the property's type.

typedDisplay.description: Ties display.as to the property's type.

items.description: Array properties only: what each value in the list is. Defaults to strings.

display.description: How the portal shows the property's values, in tables, on entity pages and in widgets. Every field is optional; the type picks the rest.

as.description: How a value looks, from those its type allows: strings text (default), badge, code, link, date or relative; numbers number (default), progress or badge; booleans check (default) or badge; arrays tags (default) or list; objects json; relations link; scorecards badge. progress runs from the property's minimum to its maximum, or 0 to 100.

unit.description: Numbers only: follows the value, such as % or ms.

colors.description: Colors badges by value: each key is one of the property's values (one of its enum, if it has one).

titles.description: Titles an enum value shown in place of its own text: each key is one of the property's values (one of its enum, if it has one). Without one, the value is shown in Title Case.

filter.description: Offers the property's values as a catalog filter. Not for lookups or objects.

hidden.description: Leaves the property off entity pages; it's still in the data.

empty.description: Shown when an entity has no value, such as No owner.

catalog.description: The blueprint's catalog page: its default columns, and tabs of widgets after the entities tab every catalog has.

columns.description: The catalog table's default columns after the title column: property names, integration, createdAt or updatedAt.

entity.description: The pages of the blueprint's entities: what shows beside the title, how the overview groups properties, and tabs of widgets after the relations and yaml tabs every entity page has. A tab named overview replaces the built-in one. Filters and jq here can use $entity, the page's entity.

sections.description: Groups of properties on the overview, in order. Properties no section lists follow them.

header.description: Properties an entity page shows beside its title.

subtitle.description: A property shown under the title, on entity pages and in the catalog.

badges.description: Properties shown as chips beside the title.

link.description: A property with format: uri the page offers to open.

properties.description: Property names, each in at most one section.
